changes.to: No official AIST/Honda spec page found. HRP-1 was Honda's P3-based platform supplied to the METI Humanoid Robotics Project (AIST exhibit text mentions it), so 'AIST' as manufacturer is questionable — maker is Honda. Left specs null. Re-checked 2026-11-17: AIST's own press releases (2002-03-19 and 2003-02-26, opened) describe HRP-1 as the humanoid platform of the METI/AIST Humanoid Robotics Project, built by Honda R&D (P3-based). AIST thus confirms the platform but publishes no HRP-1 spec table or product page, and the hardware maker is Honda, so the record stays unconfirmed with specs null.
